description: This file defines the WorkShiftService class, which provides methods for handling work shift data, including fetching default start and end times, retrieving work shifts by ID, listing work shifts, and counting work shifts. It interacts with the Data Access Object (DAO) layer and utilizes configuration traits.

classes.name: WorkShiftService
classes.description: Service class managing work shift-related operations such as retrieving default times, fetching by ID, listing, and counting work shifts.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDefaultStartAndEndTime
methods.description: Retrieves the default start and end times for a work shift, returning a WorkShiftStartAndEndTime object.

methods.name: getWorkShiftById
methods.description: Fetches a WorkShift entity by its ID.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the WorkShiftDao instance.

methods.name: setWorkShiftDao
methods.description: Setter for injecting a custom WorkShiftDao instance.

methods.name: getWorkShiftList
methods.description: Returns a list of work shifts based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftCount
methods.description: Returns the count of work shifts based on search filter parameters.

search-terms: default work shift start and end time
